cards.text:
V-TD07/001EN
Docking Deletor, Greion
Normal Unit｜ Link Joker｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[ACT](VC):[COST][Counter-Blast 2], and delete your opponent's vanguard. (Until the end of that fighter's turn, the deleted unit is turned face down, and loses its [Power] and text)
[AUTO](VC):When its attack hits a vanguard, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and bind it face down.

V-TD07/002EN
Aromatalber Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Link Joker｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and bind it face down.

V-TD07/003EN
Swift Deletor, Geali
Normal Unit｜ Link Joker｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When placed, if you have more rear-guards than your opponent, this unit gets [Power] +4000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](VC/RC):When its attack hits a vanguard, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and bind it face down. If you could not bind a rear-guard, draw a card.

V-TD07/005EN
Big Gunner of the Cataclysmic Variable Star
Normal Unit｜ Link Joker｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):If your opponent's vanguard is deleted, or if there is a face down card in your opponent's bind zone, this unit gets [Power] +4000.

V-TD07/006EN
Ferment Deletor, Gaen
Normal Unit｜ Link Joker｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle that it attacked a vanguard, [COST][retire this unit & discard a card from your hand], draw a card, choose one of your opponent's grade 1 or less rear guards, and bind it face down.

V-TD07/007EN
Breaking Deletor, Gatario
Normal Unit｜ Link Joker｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When it attacks a vanguard, if your opponent has two or less rear-guards, this unit gets [Power] +4000 until end of that battle.

V-TD07/008EN
Wheel of the Galaxy, Cosmo Chaplet
Normal Unit｜ Link Joker｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO](GC):When placed, [COST][discard a card from your hand], and one of your units cannot be hit until end of that battle.
